$schema.description: JSON Schema reference — allows editors to validate and autocomplete this file.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used for all date/time output.

paths.description: Filesystem paths to local data sources. ~ is expanded to $HOME.

activitywatch.description: Path to the ActivityWatch data directory.

chrome.description: Path to the Chrome user-data directory.

chrome_profiles.description: Chrome profile folder names to scan (e.g. ["Default", "Profile 1"]). null scans all profiles found.

git_authors.description: Email addresses used for git authorship. Commits matching any are credited to you.

discover_repos.description: Auto-discovery strategy for git repositories. Set to "github_desktop" to import all repos registered in the GitHub Desktop app.

chrome_correlation_window_seconds.description: Back-fill empty Chrome ActivityWatch events with a URL from Chrome history if a visit falls within this many seconds.

min_event_seconds_to_show.description: Hide activity segments shorter than this many seconds from output.

projects.description: Named projects, each clustering one or more signals (repos, domains, Slack workspaces, etc.).

personal_hosts.description: Browser hostnames to bucket as personal (not work) when no project matches. Glob-style * is supported.

personal_apps.description: Application names (as reported by ActivityWatch) to bucket as personal.

ignored_projects.description: Configured project names that should be ignored in classification and reports.

groupings_map.description: Rules for the set-integration-groupings tool: maps integration connection names to project grouping labels.

connections.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns matched against integration connection names. Keys are patterns (e.g. "*bethink*"), values are the grouping label to assign. Evaluated in order; first match wins.

clickup_default.description: Fallback grouping applied to ClickUp-sourced projects when no connection pattern matches.

priority.description: Ordered list of grouping labels. When a project matches multiple groupings (e.g. it has both Harvest and ClickUp entries from different clients), the first label in this list wins.

integrations.description: Optional external integrations for imported time/activity rows.

project.description: A named cluster of signals. All keys are optional — list only what applies.

repos.description: Absolute or ~-relative paths to git repositories belonging to this project.

repo_remotes.description: Snapshot of git remote names/URLs keyed by local repo path for cross-reference when paths change.

vscode_dirs.description: VSCode workspace folder names to match against window titles (case-insensitive).

domains.description: Browser hostnames for this project. Glob-style * is supported (e.g. *.example.com).

ssh_hosts.description: SSH hostnames matched against terminal window titles. Glob-style * is supported.

apps.description: Application names (or glob patterns) matched against ActivityWatch app names.

harvest_projects.description: Harvest project-name globs mapped to this local project.

clickup_tasks.description: ClickUp task-name or description globs mapped to this local project.

grouping.description: Client or billing group this project belongs to. Projects with the same grouping are shown together under a shared section header in reports.

slack_rule.description: A Slack matching rule. Matches any channel in the workspace when channel_glob is omitted.

channel_glob.description: Glob pattern for channel names (case-insensitive). Omit to match any channel in the workspace.

team_id.description: One team ID (string) or multiple team IDs (array of strings) to query.

usernames.description: GitHub login names used to match PR/issue/comment activity.

authors.description: GitHub usernames or emails used to filter commit activity. Falls back to git_authors when omitted.

llm_connection.description: An OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenAI, etc.).

base_url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, including the /v1 path (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1).

api_key.description: API key sent as Bearer token. Many local endpoints accept any non-empty string.

model.description: Default model name to use when no model is specified at call time.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
